name: nestjs-ai-gateway-dashboard
description: OpenAI-compatible LLM gateway (NestJS) with a typed SDK and a Next.js admin dashboard.

scripts.build:packages: npm run build -w @aigw/shared && npm run build -w @aigw/sdk
scripts.typecheck: npm run build:packages && npm run typecheck --workspaces --if-present
scripts.test: npm run build:packages && npm run test --workspaces --if-present
scripts.build: npm run build:packages && npm run build -w @aigw/gateway && npm run build -w @aigw/dashboard
